sentences.text: Perusal of same order, prima-facie, makes out a case for interim-relief.

Hence, we pass the following order:-
1APL 692.19.odt (i)

The learned APP on instructions of the Food Safety Officer, Nagpur submits that in terms of provisions of Section 38(1)
(c) proviso of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, necessary bond with an undertaking would be taken from the applicant herein.

He further states that, if such bond with the undertaking is executed voluntarily by the applicant, the respondents shall de-seal the Grocery Shop of the applicant within seven days from the date of execution of bond and undertaking.

(ii) The learned Advocate for the applicant, on instructions, submits that the applicant is ready to execute the bond in terms of Section 38(1)(c) proviso of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and is also ready to file an undertaking to the effect that in future he would not keep contraband articles like Gutkha etc. in his shop and he will not use his shop for storing those articles in future.
We further direct that though investigation to continue, charge-sheet shall not be filed without seeking leave of this Court.
JUDGE JUDGE Sumit Ritesh S/O Rajkumar Toshniwal vs State Of Mah.
